overview: A modern, high-conversion portfolio website for a fresher web design startup. Built with glassmorphic dark theme, neon accents, and smooth animations to impress potential clients and convert them into paying customers.
features: Sticky glassmorphic navbar with smooth scroll navigation
Animated hero section with dual CTAs
Tech stack & tools showcase with hover animations
Website types catalogue with icons and descriptions
Portfolio section with 3-6 demo project cards
Why Choose Us section with 5 benefit cards
Contact form with WhatsApp and Email CTAs
Loading animation and hover effects throughout
